schema_reference: Prisma model `job_postings`: primary key `job_posting_id` (UUID string), display title `job_title` (VarChar 255). This file uses `job_id` = `job_posting_id`.
sourcing_note: All ten records: job_id, job_title, and spans align with prisma/mock-data/job_postings.json job_description text (UTF-8), including curly apostrophes/quotes where present. Omitted context signals when no supporting phrase exists (e.g. numeric team_size). Prisma job_postings.location is not echoed here unless the same wording appears in the description body.
_field_guide_context: Context labels use the same shape as agents.common.types.extraction_schemas.ContextSignal. There is no top-level "text" field — quoted text and offsets live under source_span (text, field_source, start_char, end_char). Allowed signal_type literals: remote_policy | team_size | reporting_structure | work_methodology | ai_adoption_signal.
